profile.context: French, works in a bank, but the office itself is relaxed/casual - not suits-and-ties. Lots of devs in t-shirts and jeans, polos, puffer vests, sneakers. Nobody looks out of place in casual gear; the bar isn't 'formal', it's 'not sloppy, not dated'.
profile.goal: Look respectable and current, not dated; not like a 50-year-old - within a genuinely casual office, so this is about looking sharp/current relative to a low bar, not about out-dressing the room
profile.workUniform: Trousers/jeans + shoes/sneakers + a top layer (jumper or polo); puffer vest or casual jacket on top all winter - this is completely normal at the office, not a compromise
